annotations.title: Ask several humans whether an action is OK

description: Several real people judge whether an action an agent is about to take is OK – yes, no or it depends – with reasons. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

action.description: What the agent is about to do, in plain words (no personal data).

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.
